account:
Today I have been keeping my appointments and asking about town news. The unusual report is that the bakery was being decorated with lights. My neighbour heard this from Townsfolk 02, but I have not seen decorations myself or spoken to Townsfolk 02. The neighbour also asked the baker about it. The baker denied arranging decorations or planning a celebration and said baking this morning might account for the lights. That is a plausible explanation; I do not yet know whether there is any gathering. Townsfolk also reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the bridge, which could simply be normal business supplying the west-bank stall. The baker asked whether upcoming gatherings would need extra bread, rather than acknowledging any known event.

My neighbour personally confirmed our usual three o'clock tea at the east-bank cottage, coordinates (16, -60, 105). The secretary separately investigated but reported that dock workers had not confirmed the host or invitation. I tried to tell the secretary my confirmation, but my words were not heard, so this discrepancy need not mean anything suspicious. The secretary has the appointment book and reminded me of one o'clock accounts. I have now reached town hall at 13:19 and should attend to those accounts and clarify the tea arrangements with the secretary. I remain curious about the bakery lights, but there is not enough evidence to conclude that anyone is organising something secretly or to identify its purpose.
